definitions.gloss: to squeeze out; to wring out
definitions.explanation: To physically extract liquid or substance by squeezing or wringing. Emphasizes thoroughness — getting every last drop.
To take money, labor, or resources from someone by coercion or unfair means. Carries a strongly negative connotation.

notes:
Godan verb (⟦{五段|ごだん}→五段：28275_godan⟧). Transitive.

A compound of ⟦{搾|しぼ}る→搾る：18724_shiboru⟧ (to squeeze) and ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take). The ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ component adds the nuance of extraction — not just squeezing but actually getting something out.

ASPECT (ている):
- {搾|しぼ}り{取|と}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is in the process of exploiting; has squeezed out)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{搾|しぼ}る→搾る：18724_shiboru⟧ means to squeeze but without the emphasis on extraction
- ⟦{搾取|さくしゅ}→搾取：12820_sakushu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is the more formal/political term for exploitation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{搾|しぼ}り{取|と}る (to squeeze money out of)
- ⟦{汁|しる}→汁：10462_shiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{搾|しぼ}り{取|と}る (to squeeze out the juice)
- {搾|しぼ}り{取|と}れる⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧{搾|しぼ}り{取|と}る (to squeeze out as much as possible)
